routine_corollary_ruling: Elbracht-Kneip-Teegen (arXiv:2103.13162, Lemma 4.1 / Corollary 4.2) give a general necessary condition (acyclic dependency digraph) for sublevel sets of submodular functions; they do not mention the monomial family or the Brakensiek-Gopi-Guruswami conjecture. The content of the result is the specific failing instance (r,d)=(2,5) of a published SICOMP conjecture underpinning a proposed hardness reduction, located by computation; this is the small-exact-counterexample profile (346167, 369421, 349177), not a source-formula evaluation, source-ingredient bridge or modification of a printed construction. ELIGIBLE, provided the manuscript credits EKT, presents the reviewer's four-edge cycle as the shortest proof, and claims no new general obstruction.
retention: The version of record (SIAM J. Comput. 51(3) (2022) 577-626, DOI 10.1137/19M1291054) is unread (SIAM PDF 403). Required: positive evidence that Conjecture 3.33 (or its renumbered equivalent) is retained unchanged, e.g. Brakensiek's doctoral thesis, an accepted manuscript, or later citing text quoting it from the journal version.
